about: The picks of defaults that the demo videos' model, inception/mercury-2.5 through OpenRouter, made on 7 October 2026 while the takes were recorded, as the server kept them, for the library functions that the takes' cells call. Each function holds the parameters that the model picked, with their defaults as the kernel listed them. Design iteration 1.102.
